observations: Photos show a large truck-mounted borehole drilling rig (boom/derrick with long lattice/pipe frame).
A red cylindrical component is mounted on the truck chassis (likely part of the drilling system).
The truck front has a visible badge/mark that looks like “UD” on the grille area (brand not fully confirmable from these angles).
No clear model number, engine hours, drilling depth, or brand/model plate is readable in the provided photos.
No close-up photos of the drill head, mast condition, hydraulic lines, or electrical/control panel are provided.

claims.evidence: Photos show a truck-mounted drilling rig with mast/boom and drilling components (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).
No video/test run, no working drill head engagement, no operating controls shown; photos only (photo 0/1/2).

claims.claim: only if u are a serious baya pls
claims.evidence: This is seller wording only; not verifiable from photos.

risks.risk: Whether the rig actually works (engine, hydraulics, mast movement, drill head rotation/bit performance) is unknown from still photos.
risks.proof: A short video of a full operating cycle: start-up + mast raise/lower + drill head/rotation engaging the ground (or at least spinning/working off the ground) with sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven/possibly needing service (worst case: not working) until a working video/test is provided.

risks.risk: Missing/failed key parts (drill rods, bit, swivel, hoses, hydraulic leaks) can’t be confirmed; photos don’t show the drill string or critical wear parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: drill head/bit, swivel, top drive/rotation unit, and a clear view of hydraulic hoses/lines with no leaks; plus a photo list of included accessories (rods/bit/casing if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to replace missing wear parts).

risks.risk: Truck condition (engine health, gearbox, brakes, tyres, chassis) is unknown; only exterior views are shown.
risks.proof: Video of driving/idle + dashboard/engine running, and close-ups of tyres, undercarriage, and any visible leaks; include VIN/registration and service history if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-maintenance/unknown truck condition (worst case: needs repairs).

risks.risk: Capacity/ratings (max depth, hole diameter, pump specs) are unknown; this affects value heavily.
risks.proof: A readable spec plate or manual page showing drilling depth/diameter and rig model; or a document showing last job depth and bore size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest practical capacity tier (worst case: limited depth/diameter).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch between what’s shown and what’s being sold (e.g., rig mounted but missing key components).
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the full rig from multiple angles plus a checklist of what is included (drill rods length/count, bit type, pump, generator if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as rig-only with uncertain completeness (worst case: buyer must source missing items).

proof_requests: Send a short operating video: start-up, mast raise/lower, and drill head/rotation working (preferably drilling or at least engaging).
Provide close-up photos of the drill head/bit, swivel/top drive, and hydraulic hoses/lines (showing no leaks).
Provide readable spec info: rig model/serial plate and drilling depth/diameter ratings (or last job report).
Provide truck condition proof: engine running video + driving/idle, plus tyres/brakes/undercarriage close-ups.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig, but the seller’s key claim that it is “sharp and working fine” and the capacity/specs needed to price it are not verifiable from still images. Request proof of operation and readable specs before pricing.
